summary: Reviewed the seasonal resolver, dynamic details component, SSOT drift guard, SSOT structural edits, and Easter Sunday page from the provided pack only. The resolver and null-render behavior look sound, but the page and tests make a few assumptions about dynamic annual data, banned wedding language, and unshown SSOT consumers.
appears_sound: `components/seasonal/SeasonalDynamicDetails.tsx:35` correctly resolves fields and returns `null` when there are no detail rows.
`lib/seasonal-utils.ts:245` trims blank and whitespace-only fields before rendering, so empty dynamic values are safely ignored.
`components/HeroBadge.tsx:6` still reads `ssot.ratings.google.rating` and `review_count`, which were not removed by the SSOT structural change.
`app/easter-sunday/page.tsx:148` uses `InteriorHero`, and the visible page sections use lower-level headings after that.

findings.description: The Easter page says vegetarian and vegan dishes are served with vegetarian gravy, but the pack's rule says the Wellington is vegan and the page only lists meat options plus a vegan wellington. This risks an inaccurate customer-facing dietary claim.
findings.evidence: `app/easter-sunday/page.tsx:203` says `Vegetarian and vegan dishes are served with vegetarian gravy`, while the same page lists roast beef, pork, turkey, two meat pies, and a vegan wellington.
findings.why_it_might_be_wrong: There may be another confirmed vegetarian dish outside the pack, or the gravy may be vegan despite the wording.
findings.what_would_confirm: Check the current Sunday roast menu source or owner-confirmed dietary guidance.

findings.description: The banned-strings guard excludes `dining_room_history`, but SSOT still contains `wedding reception` there. If that history field is rendered anywhere, the new test gives false confidence against the hard rule of no wedding claims.
findings.evidence: `tests/ssot-drift-guard.test.ts:46` skips `dining_room_history`, while `SSOT.json:1431` contains `George and Alex Best's wedding reception`.
findings.why_it_might_be_wrong: The field may be internal historical context and never rendered to customers.
findings.what_would_confirm: Search for consumers of `history.dining_room_history` and decide whether the wedding wording is allowed history or banned customer copy.

findings.description: The page claims annual details can be refreshed through the dynamic fields, but the event schema uses separate hardcoded Easter date constants. Updating `EASTER_SUNDAY_DYNAMIC` would not update JSON-LD dates, so the SEO event data can drift from the visible annual details.
findings.why_it_might_be_wrong: The owner may intend a code edit each year for schema dates, with dynamic fields only for optional visible rows.
findings.what_would_confirm: Clarify whether A11 dynamic fields must drive structured data as well as the visible details block.

findings.description: Several `private_hire` price fields changed from numbers to the string sentinel `LIVE_FROM_DB`. That satisfies the no-hardcoded-price rule, but any unshown consumer that formats or compares these as numbers could now break.
findings.evidence: `SSOT.json:1108` through `SSOT.json:1112` replace numeric catering and Christmas menu prices with `LIVE_FROM_DB`.
findings.why_it_might_be_wrong: The provided consumer snippets do not read these fields, so there may be no runtime consumer.
findings.what_would_confirm: Search for `christmas_menus_from_gbp`, `catering_buffet_from_gbp`, and related keys in pages, schemas, and scripts.

findings.description: The pack removes top-level SSOT strategy keys, but it does not include `scripts/audit-menu-pages.js`, which the review focus names as a consumer. The provided evidence verifies HeroBadge and menu-page-data only.
findings.evidence: `SSOT.json:1325` replaces `target_audiences`, `psychographic_segments`, and `competitive_landscape` with `_strategy_doc`, while the pack only shows `components/HeroBadge.tsx` and `lib/menu-page-data.ts` consumer snippets.
findings.why_it_might_be_wrong: `scripts/audit-menu-pages.js` may not read those removed keys.
findings.what_would_confirm: Inspect `scripts/audit-menu-pages.js` for reads of the removed SSOT keys.

empty_categories: No empty-state defect found in `SeasonalDynamicDetails`; it renders nothing when no detail rows resolve.
No partial-field crash found in the seasonal resolver; missing, blank, start-only, and end-only time fields are handled.
No removed-key use is visible in the provided `HeroBadge` or `menu-page-data` consumers.
No hardcoded food menu prices found in the Easter page copy; the visible pound amount is a booking deposit, which the pack allows.
No single-H1 issue is visible in the provided Easter page code.
